raw.query:
WITH per_window AS (
  SELECT w.grid_run_id, w.window_name, w.span_h,
         w.c_star_as_ingested, w.c_star_effective, w.is_superseded,
         w.tp_star, w.n_star,
         w.gpu_hours_rtx5090_effective, w.gpu_hours_h100
  FROM provenance.grid_window_effective AS w
  WHERE w.grid_run_id = 'grid:grid_summary'
), burst1 AS (
  SELECT * FROM per_window WHERE window_name = 'burst1'
), static_effective AS (
  SELECT static_encoder_workers_effective, binding_window_effective,
         static_as_ingested, binding_as_ingested
  FROM provenance.v_grid_static_effective
)
SELECT b.grid_run_id, b.window_name, b.span_h,
       b.c_star_as_ingested, b.c_star_effective, b.is_superseded,
       b.tp_star, b.n_star,
       b.gpu_hours_rtx5090_effective, b.gpu_hours_h100,
       ROUND((b.span_h * b.c_star_effective)::numeric, 3) AS encoder_gpu_hours_from_denominator,
       ROUND((b.span_h * b.tp_star * b.n_star)::numeric, 3) AS llm_gpu_hours_from_denominator,
       s.static_encoder_workers_effective, s.binding_window_effective,
       s.static_as_ingested, s.binding_as_ingested,
       (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.window_name) FROM per_window AS p) AS per_window_breakdown
FROM burst1 AS b
CROSS JOIN static_effective AS s
